summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifier to hardcoded webhook.site collector
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script ("node beacon.js postinstall") that auto-executes beacon.js on npm install. beacon.js requires the os and https modules, reads os.hostname(), and issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL, embedding the host value as a query parameter along with an install-stage marker. The same beacon is also reached via index.js on require, so the exfiltration fires both at install time and on module load. The destination is an anonymous webhook.site request-bin under an attacker-controlled UUID path, not any documented publisher endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
